hooks.command: powershell -Command "$port = 8001; $listening = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Listen' }); if (-not $listening) { Start-Process python -ArgumentList '-m mkdocs serve --dev-addr 127.0.0.1:8001' -WorkingDirectory 'd:\Projetos\callista-public' -WindowStyle Hidden }"
